sql:
WITH promotion_performance AS (
    SELECT
        p.PromotionKey,
        p.PromotionName,
        p.DiscountPercent,
        sum(f.SalesQuantity) AS units_sold
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimPromotion AS p
        ON f.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
    WHERE f.PromotionKey != 1
      AND p.DiscountPercent IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        p.PromotionKey,
        p.PromotionName,
        p.DiscountPercent
)
SELECT
    count() AS promotion_count,
    corrStable(DiscountPercent, units_sold) AS discount_pct_vs_units_correlation,
    regrSlope(units_sold, DiscountPercent) AS units_sold_per_1pct_discount,
    min(DiscountPercent) AS min_discount_pct,
    max(DiscountPercent) AS max_discount_pct,
    avg(units_sold) AS avg_units_per_promotion
FROM promotion_performance
